configuration_notes: Unmeasured structural transfer: no default adoption or original-result credit.
One global trainer configuration per matched task comparison. Architecture, data, prior, initialization, budget and sampling belong to tasks.
See docs/forge-search-spaces.md for finite random subsets, conditional categories and immutable manifests.
overview: Halloween transfers the inspected historical G/D Adam settings and [-1,1,1] least-squares labels through the public API. Original HyperGAN execution and trained success remain unbound. This new family is unmeasured.
pseudocode: Draw task-owned real and latent batches from isolated streams.
Minimize half the mean of (D(real)-1)^2 plus (D(fake)+1)^2 for D.
Minimize half the mean of (D(fake)-1)^2 for G; joint hosts add the reversed real-stream encoder term.
Apply role-specific dense legacy Adam, incrementing each optimizer application clock.
Save role clocks, powers, moments, model weights and every consumed stream.

references.component: Dense Adam epsilon and bias-correction law
references.title: Inspected TensorFlow v1.3 Adam source

symbols: G is the generator, E an optional encoder, D the critic and P the task-owned prior; t counts optimizer applications.

training_details.critic_penalty: Zero additional critic penalty in the transfer preset.
training_details.damping_and_guards: No A2 damping, critic guard, anchor or direct-particle response.
training_details.learning_rates: Constant rates: G .008020980209802098, D .003947939479394794. Prior multiplier 2 with its own (0,.999) betas and 1e-8 epsilon. Original decay is unbound; explicit exponential whole-update schedules are optional new variants.
training_details.loss: Least squares with fake/real/G labels (-1,1,1); joint encoder stream is explicit.
training_details.noise: No additive training input/output noise. Task-owned MoG kernel noise and clean sampling remain explicit.
training_details.optimizer: Dense TensorFlow-v1 Adam formula implemented in PyTorch; different G/D betas and epsilon, no AMSGrad or weight decay.
